notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've made a ton of progress since the last update, and we're excited to share it with you. But first, let's get to the big news - our official release date!

📅 March 20th at 3:00 PM (US Pacific Time)
We can’t wait for you to embark on this journey with us and experience the world we’ve created!

So What’s New?

You can always track our progress on our roadmap: superusergames.com/roadmap

We've been focusing on expanding your gear and crafting options. Now, you can create a variety of items to enhance your experience.


 Progression System – Levels have been introduced to streamline progression. With each level, you'll unlock new buildings and upgrades for your plot.
 Fishing & Crafting Enhancements – You can now turn fish into fish guts, which are used to craft baits and incenses. Extract fish eggs, breed new species, or raise them from eggs to big strong fish!
 Farming Refinery – This new system allows you to grind plants into plant mill, a key ingredient for bait and incense crafting.
 Expanded Workbenches – You can refine fish in multiple ways to maximize your fishing potential.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800707/b9ddd915d19859c542b3c8a44cc53da9f9ef1ac3.png
Building System Overhaul

We've revamped the building system! With each level, you’ll unlock five new buildables across different categories:

 Workbenches – Craft baits, fishing rods, rod parts, and more.
 Houses – Increase your inventory space.
 Props – Customize your plot with decorations.
 Farming Plots – Grow plants for crafting materials.
 Boosters – Structures that enhance your farm (e.g., beehives make crops grow faster!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800707/86e43e4624a884b6c5b788c5bee3754cb96cc84c.png
There are plenty of levels and unlockable items to discover!

Boat Fishing Improvements

Set sail to find ripples in the water! Using open-sea baits, you can now fish beyond the shore and explore deeper waters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800707/0485261add9eca961463bcc7294e626e186a0da5.png
What’s Next?

We’re in the final stretch! Here’s what we’re focusing on before launch:

✅ Completing the main mission arc
✅ Enhancing the UI
✅ Polishing the overall gameplay experience

Oh, and one more thing—we’ve got a brand-new island in the works! But we’re keeping it a secret for now… you’ll have to discover it in-game. 😉

Thanks for your support—we can’t wait for you to dive in! 🎣✨

notes.title: Two and a Half Months Later: A Huge Thank You!
notes.content:
It’s been an incredible journey since our demo launched during October’s Steam Next Fest, and we want to say thank you to everyone who played, shared feedback, and supported us. Your input has been invaluable, and we’ve made some big changes to improve the game!

So let's go over what we've changed!


     Smoother Camera and Controls
One of the more frequent comments we got was to fix the choppy camera on the player. 
We understand that these types of games need to have smooth controls to make the cozy feeling even better. So We prioritized that going forward. Implementing satisfying and straightforward controller support is our priority.
     Revamped Opening Scene
Another common feedback we got was improving the start of the game. So we are changing it completely, now we made a new and improved starting scene, removing the slow paced dialogue with a voiced over cutscene.
     Fishing UI Overhaul
A lot of people found fishing UI a bit confusing, and as a main mechanic of the game it was really concerning. To change it we implemented a nicer tutorial, as well as more inputs of what needs to be done.
 New Activities: Boat Races
In addition to fish-offs, you can now compete in boat-offs! Race across unique island tracks, enter tournaments, and upgrade your boat for better performance.
 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800707/2ad69b1504f8d777c909f4fc415d7237da6c349e.jpg

We’ve received a lot of feedback regarding the story feeling awkward so we’re changing the dialogue to feel a lot more alive and lifelike. Since with the demo we were rushing to prepare everything for Steam Next Fest, we acknowledge that we didn’t really put the desired effort in and that it needs to be implemented correctly in order to feel a lot better.

The story line will stay the same as per plan, but the dialogues will change just a bit.

We’ve also decided to reduce the number of side missions with dialogue, and instead focus on gameplay oriented missions. What that means is that instead of having long conversations with characters with different choices, there will be more fish catching auctions, building to help other villagers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800707/ba6016ed0097bfc36cbfbb0938110bf968b300e3.jpg

The reason for this is to reduce the number of fetch missions with dialogue, and instead offer a reward for being a good fisherman and a treasure hunter.

Finding the right balance between different types of missions is key to making the game feel a lot better.

Early Access is Coming!
We’re thrilled to announce that we’re closing in on our early access release! With that, the demo will soon be taken offline to pave the way for this next step. If you haven’t tried the demo yet, don’t worry the full experience is just around the corner.

If you want more frequent updates You can join our Discord here: https://discord.com/invite/hyRKS4YXS8

Thank you for your continued support
